description: Page through covered laptop and Chromebook models, sorted by slug (A to Z), optionally filtered by brand or category. Use it to browse or enumerate models; to check whether a brand, model or part type is covered at all (with per-type fit counts in one call) use get_coverage; for one model's parts use get_model_parts; to find a model from free text use search_parts or resolve_request. Page size is 20 by default, or 100 when brand or category is given; max 100. Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page; pages are stable for the same data_revision. total is the full count.

brand.description: Optional manufacturer name, case-insensitive, e.g. Lenovo, Dell, HP

limit.description: Page size: default 20, or 100 when brand or category is given; max 100

name: list_models

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: List laptop models
